---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, enhancement, or new capability for AuraMusic
title: '[FEAT] <Short description of proposal>'
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

## Proposed Feature
A clear and concise description of what feature or capability you are proposing.

## Problem Solved
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe the scenario (e.g., "I find it difficult to organize long playlists without sorting options...").

## Expected Behavior
Describe how the feature would look, feel, and function from a user perspective.

## Architectural Rationale
Why does this feature belong in AuraMusic, and how does it fit into the on-device, serverless, Liquid Glass vision?

## Additional Context or Mockups
Add any screenshots, sketches, or conceptual references that clarify your proposal.
